sanskrit: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः । तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये    यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी ॥
hindiTranslation: उसके बाद उस परमपदपरमात्मा की खोज करनी चाहिये जिसको प्राप्त होनेपर मनुष्य फिर लौटकर संसारमें नहीं आते और जिससे अनादिकालसे चली आनेवाली यह सृष्टि विस्तारको प्राप्त हुई है, उस आदिपुरुष परमात्माके ही मैं शरण हूँ ॥
englishTranslation: Therefore one should seek that supreme state, reaching which one does not return again. I take refuge in that original Person from whom this ancient creation has spread forth.
essence: The final refuge is a state where return itself stops.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Beyond the changing world lies a supreme state where return stops. Krishna says that state should be sought, and he himself takes refuge in the original Person from whom creation unfolds.
simpleInsight: Seek the place of no return, and take refuge in the original Person.
detailedMeaning: Krishna leads him past the tangled world-tree of change. After showing how to cut free from the lower world, Krishna points to the final destination: the supreme state beyond return, rooted in the original Person.
modernRelevance: After a parent's funeral, when the relatives leave and the house goes quiet, many people start asking where it all comes from. Krishna answers by pointing to the original Person and asking you to take refuge there.
translationLiteral: ततः (therefore) / पदम् (state) / तत् (that) / परिमार्गितव्यम् (should be sought) / यस्मिन् (in which) / गताः (gone) / न (not) / निवर्तन्ति (return) / भूयः (again) / तम् (that) / एव (indeed) / च (and) / आद्यम् (original) / पुरुषम् (Person) / प्रपद्ये (I take refuge) / यतः (from whom) / प्रवृत्तिः (emanation) / प्रसृता (spread forth) / पुराणी (ancient)
insight: After the cutting comes the search: Krishna points to the state from which no one returns.
